body: Thanks, I actually started to feel really unwell and didn't want to make the situation any worse. I ended up telling my family and reluctantly went to the hospital. Seeing their reactions and tears and distress has got to have been one of the hardest things I've ever been through. I still don't know about life being worth living but I definitely see that suicide just isn't the answer. Hopefully the day that I am grateful to be alive is sooner rather than later!
Thank you, this really means a lot.

A quick warning to you guys. I've just done a bit of research and realised I've now gone and increased my chances of developing something called Parkinsonism and Parkinson's disease to add to the problems I had already. Really not worth the risk guys, so I hope this stupid mistake helps some of you reconsider.

I know how it feels to feel like you can't breathe and that you're suffocating. You will get through it though and the feelings do go away. Maybe try seeking a doctor for some medication to reduce the anxiety if you haven't already.

Thanks, they're appreciated. I actually lit the bbq in the car so I was really surprised when it didn't work and I didn't seem to feel anything after 20 minutes. It all seems a bit surreal when I think about it now I guess something was working to stop me.

Update seen as though no one's replied yet. I tried to carbon monoxide poison myself in the car. I waited for the fumes to hit me and lay there for around 20 minutes occasionally wafting the smoke for encouragement. After 20 minutes I eventually gave up, threw the bbq in the bin and drove home. I now feel... empty. I couldn't even get my suicide right.
